name: 123 Farm (aka, Highland Springs Resort Park)
description: 123 Farm (aka, Highland Springs Resort Park) is an agritourism farm in Chisholm Trail, CA, open to visitors for seasonal picking and farm activities. Offerings follow the growing season, so what is available changes through the year. Check the website for current hours and availability.
